rows.name: Swimming bacteria
rows.citation: Fenchel T. & Thar R. (2004) Candidatus Ovobacter propellens: a large conspicuous prokaryote with an unusual motility behaviour. FEMS Microbiol Ecol 48, 231; E. coli speed from Berg H.C. & Brown D.A. (1972) Nature 239, 500
rows.notes: E. coli about 14-20 um/s; Ovobacter up to 1 mm/s

rows.notes: Walking 1.4 m/s to the 100 m record average

rows.notes: Top measured speed in wild hunts 25.9 m/s

rows.name: ThrustSSC land speed record

rows.name: Parker Solar Probe

rows.name: Earth in its orbit
